summary: lore_for wraps the shipped bestiary as a read-only tool, carrying the approximate flag rather than hiding a noun-only match

coordination.notes: Extends G2's registry rather than adding a second one. bestiary.ts's loreFor/isApproximate stay the only lookup: nothing here re-derives a creature from a name. approximate travels with the result because 773 creatures share 408 nouns, so a noun-only hit is weaker evidence and a result that hid the difference would let a model state a level the data cannot support - the same reason bestiary.ts keeps its two indexes apart.
